_rules: One entry per asset before work starts. status: todo -> blockout -> built -> accepted (accepted only after an art-critic PASS).
source is decided with the routing in references/modeling.md section 2 and never changed silently.
Third-party or generated assets also get a row in assets/LICENSES.md.
Declare semantic parts/joints/sockets/collision before building. Never merge pieces that gameplay must control separately.
Keep editable source/build.py even when an export copy merges static geometry.
